portassets.screen.title: MineColonies port — external assets
portassets.screen.manual.title: Manual install (offline)
portassets.screen.manual.line1: 1. Download the official MineColonies 1.21.1 mod jar from CurseForge
portassets.screen.manual.line2: (the other mods are already bundled — GPL license).
portassets.screen.manual.line4: 3. Restart the game and press 'Download now' — the loader extracts
portassets.screen.manual.line5: it from the jar without any network access.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.mounted: Not just two empty halves of coconut.
com.minecolonies.research.combat.ivermec: Just worm-free horses, despite what some may say...
com.minecolonies.research.combat.bucepha: They will go down in history.
portassets.screen.manual.towntalk: Addon packs (TownTalk voices, Byzantine + StyleColonies styles):
portassets.screen.manual.towntalk2: put their official jars into the same source-jars folder as well.
portassets.screen.explain1: [Download now] downloads the packs listed above into <game-dir>/port-assets/ and activates them immediately — no restart needed.
portassets.screen.explain2: No internet, or downloads keep failing? [Manual install] shows the offline way. The small link below the buttons starts the game without the art (missing textures — no crash).
portassets.screen.status.restart: Downloaded — restart the game to activate the packs.
portassets.screen.what1: This port ships without the original MineColonies art and data (ARR license).
portassets.screen.what2: The buttons below fetch it from the official CurseForge pages.
portassets.screen.status.stylesactive: Assets + building styles active — no restart needed.
portassets.screen.status.stylesrestart: Packs active — building styles appear after a game restart.
portassets.screen.what.short: Port without the original ARR art — the buttons below fetch it:
portassets.screen.explain.short: [Download now] fetches the packs above and activates them immediately — no restart.
portassets.screen.skip.tooltip: The game runs, but MineColonies blocks and items show missing textures and the building styles are absent.\nThis notice reappears on every launch until the assets are provided.
portassets.screen.download.tooltip: Fetches the packs listed above from the official CurseForge pages into <game-dir>/port-assets/ and activates them immediately — no restart needed.
portassets.error.offline: No internet connection or the network failed — check your connection and press Retry.
portassets.error.stall: The connection dropped mid-download (no data for 30 s) — press Retry.
portassets.error.http: The download server answered: %s — try again later, or use [Manual install].
